text: This report submits the draft 2021 financial statements for approval. The Policy and Finance Committee reviewed the financial statements on May 24, 2022 and recommended it for approval by the Board.

The Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo: 1. Approved the draft Financial Statement of the Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo for the year ended December 31, 2021 as attached in Attachment 1 to the report (May 24, 2022) from the Controller, Finance, Toronto Zoo.
